commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Pedro Porro (Spain) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+5' The goal by Spain is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+3' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Spain players aren’t happy.
90+2' Goal! Ferran Torres (Spain) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Pedro Porro. The score is 5:0.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Nasser Al Dawsari walks off the pitch and Khalid Al Ghannam (Saudi Arabia) comes on as a substitute.
90' Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' The game is interrupted now, Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
85' Saud Abdulhamid (Saudi Arabia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
84' Aymeric Laporte (Spain) was too forceful with his tackle and Raphael Claus interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
83' Marc Cucurella (Spain) brings an opponent down and Raphael Claus interrupts the game.
82' Yeremy Pino (Spain) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.

81' Abdullah Al Hamdan (Saudi Arabia) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon was ready and made a save.
80' Ferran Torres (Spain) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
78' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Fabian Ruiz (Spain) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' An attempted cross from Pedro Porro (Spain) is cleared.
70' That's the end of the game for Pedri, who is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Spain).
68' A cooling break is underway.
68' Flag up against Rodri (Spain). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
68' Nico Williams (Spain) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
67' Nico Williams (Spain) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Spain.
66' Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

65' Mikel Merino plays a pass to Ferran Torres (Spain), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
63' Ferran Torres (Spain) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
61' That will be all from Alex Baena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nico Williams (Spain).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mikel Merino (Spain) will replace Dani Olmo.
60' It's time for a substitution. Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) comes on in place of Firas Al Buraikan.
60' Georgios Donis has decided to make a change. Alaa Hejji (Saudi Arabia) replaces Abdulelah Al Amri.
60' Raphael Claus shows a yellow card to Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
58' Pedri (Spain) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
56' Alex Baena (Spain) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
55' Pedri (Spain) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' Alex Baena (Spain) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

52' Pedro Porro (Spain) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mohammed Al Owais is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
49' 4 - 0 Hassan Tambakti (Saudi Arabia) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
48' Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Pedro Porro (Spain) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Spain have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Nasser Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) will not participate anymore and Abdullah Al Hamdan is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Georgios Donis decided to make a change. Abdullah Al Khaibari (Saudi Arabia) is replaced by Mohamed Kanno.
46' Luis de la Fuente makes a switch. Ferran Torres is coming on in place of Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) at the start of the second period.
46' Luis de la Fuente makes a half-time substitution. Yeremy Pino comes on in place of Lamine Yamal (Spain).
46' Raphael Claus blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' The foul by Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) was seen by Raphael Claus who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+4' Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+4' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+3' Alex Baena (Spain) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45+3' A cross into the box from Marc Cucurella (Spain) is cleared. Now Spain have a corner.

45+1' Rodri (Spain) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia).
44' Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Saudi Arabia are awarded a corner kick.
42' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
41' Saud Abdulhamid (Saudi Arabia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
41' Dani Olmo (Spain) makes a rough challenge and Raphael Claus blows his whistle for a foul.

40' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Baena (Spain) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
39' Pedri (Spain) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' Pedro Porro (Spain) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
38' Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
37' Lamine Yamal (Spain) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
36' A snap shot by Lamine Yamal (Spain) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Mohammed Al Owais produces a good save to thwart him.
36' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
36' Abdulelah Al Amri (Saudi Arabia) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
35' Spain players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
33' Lamine Yamal (Spain) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Today's referee Raphael Claus rightly decides to book Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) for his harsh tackle.

30' Lamine Yamal (Spain) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
29' Alex Baena (Spain) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' 3 - 0 Goal! Dani Olmo gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:0.
23' Lamine Yamal (Spain) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
21' 2 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Aymeric Laporte knock down. 2:0.
20' Good work from Spain as they win a corner.
20' The ball is cleared after Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Spain as they win a corner.
17' Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
17' Lamine Yamal (Spain) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mohammed Al Owais intercepts the ball.
16' Alex Baena (Spain) commits a foul and Raphael Claus immediately signals a free kick.
15' Alex Baena (Spain) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
14' Marc Cucurella (Spain) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
14' A rebound falls kindly for Pedri (Spain), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
13' Neat link-up play between Lamine Yamal (Spain) and Alex Baena, but Mohammed Al Owais reads the game well and the move breaks down.
10' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mikel Oyarzabal plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Lamine Yamal (Spain). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.

10' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Pedro Porro (Spain), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
10' Alex Baena (Spain) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

8' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Dani Olmo (Spain), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Saudi Arabia will have a goal kick.
8' The ball is out of play. Spain win a corner kick.
8' Marc Cucurella (Spain) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Spain win a corner kick.
8' Lamine Yamal (Spain) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
7' Good defending. Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) tries to find Firas Al Buraikan inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
6' Pedro Porro (Spain) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Lamine Yamal (Spain) produces an awful long-range shot that goes high and wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Saudi Arabia.
3' A lofted cross from Lamine Yamal (Spain) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
3' Lamine Yamal (Spain) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
2' Alex Baena (Spain) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Spain have a corner.
1' Lamine Yamal (Spain) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' A cross from Alex Baena (Spain) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Spain will have the kick-off.
Raphael Claus will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
